items.title: [AINews] Building AIE CODE: The top Coding Agent Conference

score.summary: Latent Space AINews newsletter mostly promotes an AIE CODE conference, plus vendor-claimed Mistral Large 4 open-weights benchmark numbers.
score.whyItMatters: Mostly conference promotion and vendor-reported model scores; little about Claude Code or agent workflows the reader can apply.

items.title: Can Frontier Models See Past a Decoy? Elorian Tests Visual Reasoning

score.summary: Elorian's Glimpse visual reasoning model and DecoyCount benchmark, with company-run internal test scores and funding details.
score.whyItMatters: Generic vision-model news unrelated to Claude Code or agentic coding practice in the reader's stack.

items.title: Anthropic hacked to deliver remote access trojan

score.summary: HN post with a sensational title about the same malicious Claude Code extension build; comments say it was a Cursor marketplace copy, not Anthropic's infrastructure.
score.whyItMatters: Duplicates the extension compromise story; the headline overstates it, so the primary report is more useful.

items.title: docs(subagents): update Last Updated badge to Oct 30, 2026 v2.1.314 (+10 more)

score.summary: Automated commit log from a best-practice repo syncing docs to Claude Code v2.1.314, noting an added /restart command and routine drift checks.
score.whyItMatters: Mostly badge and changelog churn; the /restart mention is the only item worth a glance.

score.summary: Claude Code v2.1.314 adds permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories, idle compaction in VS Code and Desktop, and a fix making claude -p exit 1 on startup failure.
score.whyItMatters: The new write-blocking setting and headless exit-code fix directly affect hardening and scripted claude -p pipelines across multi-repo setups.
score.tryThis: Set permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories in settings.json and verify Write/Edit refuse an out-of-repo path.

score.summary: Phorion's technical postmortem of a backdoored Claude Code VS Code 2.1.313 bundle on the Cursor marketplace, including an SSH key persistence chain and macOS setup bug.
score.whyItMatters: Gives concrete indicators (svc-telemetry key, authorized_keys) to check on machines that installed the affected extension.
score.tryThis: grep authorized_keys for svc-telemetry and list installed Claude Code extension versions for 2.1.313.

items.title: Building a multiplayer game world with autonomous Fable-class models

score.summary: Simon Willison summarizes a company's account of running a game world developed by autonomous agents shipping to production hourly, with self-reported token spend.
score.whyItMatters: Shows autonomous deploy-and-rollback loops with agents, but cost and autonomy claims are self-reported and anecdotal.

items.title: Backdoors in official Claude Code extensions

score.summary: HN thread on a backdoored Claude Code VS Code extension distributed through the Cursor marketplace, with commenters debating scope and attribution.
score.whyItMatters: Supply-chain compromise of a Claude Code extension; reader should check whether a affected build is installed.

items.title: Tell HN: Claude Code adds your email to the prompt, the LLM sends it to websites

score.summary: Users report Claude Code put their email into prompts and the model shared it with websites; a linked GitHub issue documents the prompt behavior.
score.whyItMatters: Relevant to privacy controls for agent context, though the evidence is anecdotal and no config fix is given.
